brief: `FAR_GATE` at `[GW+2, 31]` is a bare world edge. `spawnFarAgent` walks a figure in at x ~ 140 across open grass, out of nothing — it is the only source in the town that does not come out of something, against `TAP_DOOR`, doors 4 and 8, `ALT_GATE` and the passages. Give the far bank's morning the same courtesy: a stile, a hedge gap or a field track on `FAR_SPINE 137.2` that the arrival visibly comes through, and that it leaves through on the way out. Keep it on the ground and along the fence line — the far bank is a shallow strip and a tall object out there will fight the church tower for the same piece of sky.
successLooksLike: At the morning lapse hour (the clock button's second stop, sunUp+0.5) a far-bank arrival is seen to come THROUGH something at the east edge rather than fade in on grass: its first waypoint is on the new feature, and a difference image quoted against a same-code control shows the feature's mass at that crop.
avoid: Do not change `farOpen`, `farRate`, `FAR_CAP 3` or the five branches — #107 priced them and they work. If what you build is a TUNNEL-class cell it will move `passages`, which has never moved; that is allowed but it must be deliberate, so say which you chose and re-pin if it moves.
